chapters.title: ASIA HIGH & LOW
chapters.text: Asia closes: ASIA HIGH 26107.75 and ASIA LOW 25909.00 are final. They carry forward as dotted lines until Asia opens again.

chapters.title: ASIA HIGH TAKEN
chapters.text: The first bar to reach the ASIA HIGH 26107.75 closes at 26123.00, above it: the level is taken and the rest of its dotted line fades. A wick would not count; it takes a close.

chapters.title: LONDON HIGH & LOW
chapters.text: London closes: LONDON HIGH 26207.50 and LONDON LOW 25977.25 are final. They carry forward as dotted lines until London opens again.

chapters.title: LONDON HIGH TAKEN
chapters.text: The first bar to reach the LONDON HIGH 26207.50 closes at 26224.00, above it: the level is taken and the rest of its dotted line fades. A wick would not count; it takes a close.
